description: Get an OpenAPI 3.0 specification for a BANKSapi API, or a targeted slice of one. Available specs: banks-connect (main API), ai-connect (AI features), pay-connect (payments). Pass operation_id to get just that operation with the schemas it references (strongly preferred — the full specs are large). Pass tag to get every operation of one section. With neither, returns the entire spec. To discover operationIds and tags, fetch the API index via get-banksapi-docs-page('/api/<spec_name>'). Returns YAML for YAML specs, JSON for JSON specs.
name: get-banksapi-openapi-spec
title: Get BANKSapi OpenAPI spec
